code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Collapse a regular tiled canvas to its room grid; colored line intersections label rooms.
    rs=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row))>1 and all(v==row[0] for v in row)==False]
    # divider rows/columns are the regularly repeated solid bands
    bg=grid[1][1]
    rlines=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r]))==1 or sum(v!=grid[r][0] for v in grid[r])<=2]
    # use rows where first-cell differs from normal room fill
    rlines=[r for r in range(h) if grid[r][0]!=bg and (r==0 or grid[r-1][0]==bg)]
    clines=[c for c in range(w) if grid[0][c]!=bg and (c==0 or grid[0][c-1]==bg)]
    nr=len(rlines)-1; nc=len(clines)-1
    if nr<1: nr=max(1,(h-1)//5)
    if nc<1: nc=max(1,(w-1)//6)
    out=[[bg for _ in range(nc)] for _ in range(nr)]
    # marker colors at divider intersections annotate the nearest room, favoring lower/right room
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
      for c,v in enumerate(row):
        if v not in (bg,grid[0][0]):
          ri=min(nr-1,max(0,round(r/(h/nr))))
          ci=min(nc-1,max(0,round(c/(w/nc))))
          out[ri][ci]=v
    return out
'''
